content.title: 2026 NYC Half Marathon road closures, route info, map, start time and more
content.text: The route takes participants to some of the city's most iconic locations: Prospect Park, Brooklyn Bridge and Times Square before the finish line in Central Park. NBC Universal, Inc. As runners kickoff to race weekend for the world’s premier half marathon, many speakers, NYRR leadership members, Olympians and Paralympians express their excitement for the race. NBC News 4 New York’s John Chandler reports. Runners, take your mark. Everyone else, take note of the road closures. More than 30,000 runners are expected to take to the streets of Brooklyn and Manhattan for the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half Marathon. The route takes participants to some of the city's most iconic locations, as runners will start in Brooklyn's Prospect Park, cross the Brooklyn Bridge, go up FDR Drive, run through Times Square and finish the 13.1-mile race in Central Park. The first runners are scheduled to start at 7 a.m., with staggered waves taking off after that. Check out a map of the route below. Spectators can download the NYRR app to track runners, watch live leaderboards, see course maps and get live coverage of the professional field.
